questions.question: Which Bill was passed in the Parliament in 2022 to authorise payment certain sums from and out of the Consolidated Fund of India for the services of the financial year 2022-23?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Appropriation Bill.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Appropriation Bill **was passed in the** **Parliament in 2022 to authorise payment of certain sums from and out of the **Consolidated Fund of India** for the services of the financial year **2022-23.**
 
• **The Appropriation Bill is a money bill that authorizes the government to withdraw funds from the Consolidated Fund of India to meet its expenditures during the financial year.**
 
• It is introduced in the Parliament after the presentation of the **Union Budget.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Finance Bill is also a money bill that deals with the government's revenue and expenditure proposals for the upcoming financial year. **
 
• The Electricity (Amendment) Bill is a non-money bill that seeks to amend the Electricity Act, 2003 to bring about reforms in the power sector, including the promotion of renewable energy and the introduction of competition in the distribution segment.
 
• **The Wild Life (Protection) Amendment Bill is also a non-money bill that seeks to amend the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 to provide for better protection of wildlife and their habitats in India.**

questions.question: Which article of the Indian constitution provides for proclamation of Emergency?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 352.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 352 **of the Indian Constitution deals with the proclamation of Emergency.
 
• **This article empowers the President of India to declare a state of emergency in the country in case of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.**
 
• **The Emergency can be declared for the whole country or a specific state or union territory.**
 
• During the Emergency, the** fundamental rights of citizens **can be suspended, and the central government takes over the administration of the affected state or the entire country.
 
• The Emergency can be** **revoked by the President after receiving the approval of both houses of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Article 364** of the Indian Constitution deals with the** appointment of an Inter-State Council** to promote coordination between states.
 
• **Article 350** deals with the appointment of a** special officer for linguistic minorities.**
 
• **Article 362** deals with the** rights of tribal people** over their land and resources.

questions.question: Which of the following planets has the shortest rotation period?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jupiter.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The question asks for the planet with the shortest rotation period, which means the planet that rotates the fastest.**
 
• **Jupiter** is the correct answer as it rotates the fastest among the given options with a period of 9.9 Earth hours.
 
• **Mercury** has a longer rotation period than Jupiter, while Mars has a similar rotation period to Earth.
 
• **Venus has the slowest rotation period among the given options.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Jupiter:** It has a rotation period of **9.9 Earth hours,** making it the **fastest rotating planet** in our solar system.
 
• **Mars:** It has a rotation period of **24.6 Earth hours,** which is similar to Earth's rotation period.
 
• **Venus:** It has a rotation period of** 243 Earth days**, making it the** slowest rotating planet** in our solar system.

questions.question: Which among the following is NOT a way to acquire Citizenship of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**By Renunciation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Renunciation** is** not** a way to acquire citizenship of India, it is a process of **giving up Indian citizenship** by a person who already possesses it.
 
• A person can renounce their Indian citizenship if they are acquiring citizenship of another country or if they no longer wish to be an Indian citizen.
 
• They need to apply for renunciation at the Indian embassy or consulate in their country of residence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **By birth:**

 
 
• If a child is born outside India to Indian parents, they can acquire Indian citizenship by registering at the nearest **Indian embassy or consulate **within one year of their birth.
 
 
 
• **By registration:**
 
 
• A person can apply for registration as an Indian citizen if they have been living in India for **seven years **and have resided in the **country for at least one year **before submitting their application.
 
 
 
• **By naturalisation:**
 
 
• A person can apply for naturalisation as an Indian citizen if they have resided in India for at least **12 years (or 11 years** for certain categories of applicants), have been of **good character**, and have an adequate knowledge of a language specified in the **Constitution of India.**

questions.question: The microorganisms which convert the dead plants and animals to humus are known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**decomposers.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decomposers** are microorganisms that break down dead organic matter, such as dead plants and animals, into simpler substances like humus.
 
• **Humus is a dark, organic material that is rich in nutrients and helps to improve soil fertility.**
 
• Decomposers play an important role in nutrient cycling, as they release nutrients from dead organic matter back into the soil, where they can be taken up by plants.
 
• Examples of decomposers include **bacteria, fungi,** and some types of insects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Producers are organisms that produce their own food through photosynthesis, such as plants and algae.**
 
• Autotrophs are organisms that can produce their own food, either through photosynthesis (like producers) or through other means, such as chemosynthesis.
 
• **Herbivores are animals that eat plants.**

questions.question: What is the relative charge of a proton and neutron?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**+1 and 0 respectively.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proton has a relative charge of +1, while neutron has a relative charge of 0.**
 
• The **charge** of an atom is determined by the** number of protons and electrons** it has.
 
• Protons and neutrons are both found in the** nucleus** of an atom.
 
• **The number of protons in an atom is the atomic number, while the total number of protons and neutrons is the mass number.**
 
• In an atom, the number of electrons is equal to the** number of protons, **making the atom electrically neutral.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A negatively charged subatomic particle known as an electron can be free (not bound) or bound to an atom.**
 
• The discovery of the electron is credited to **J. J. Thomson.**
 
• Each subshell that makes up the **KLMN shells **is only permitted a certain number of electrons.
 
• **The maximum number of electrons in the s subshell is two, the maximum number in the p subshell is six, the maximum number in the d subshell is ten, and the maximum number in the f subshell is fourteen.**

questions.question:
Public goods possess which of the following features in the economy?

I. They are non-rivalrous.

II. They are non-excludable.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Public goods are goods or services that are consumed by everyone in the society, regardless of whether they have paid for it or not.
 
• **Non-rivalrous means that one person's consumption of the good does not reduce the amount available for others.**
 
• For example, if a park is a **public good,** one person's enjoyment of the park does not prevent others from enjoying it as well.
 
• **Non-excludable means that it is difficult or impossible to prevent someone from consuming the good, even if they have not paid for it.**
 
• For example, it is difficult to prevent someone from enjoying the view of a fireworks display from a public space, even if they have not paid for a ticket to attend the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Private goods are goods or services that are consumed by individuals who have paid for them.
 
• **Private goods** **are both** **rivalrous and excludable.**
 
• **Common goods are goods or services that are available to everyone in the society but are rivalrous.**
 
• For example,** fish in a lake **can be a common good because if one person catches a fish, there is one less fish available for others to catch.
 
• **Club goods are goods or services that are non-rivalrous but excludable.**
 
• For example, a subscription to a streaming service is a club good because multiple people can consume the service at the same time without reducing the amount available for others, but only those who have paid for the subscription can access it.

questions.question: The months of ________ form a period of transition from hot rainy season to dry winter conditions.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**October-November.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **October-November** is the period when the** monsoon season** gradually comes to an **end,** and the** winter season begins** in most parts of India.
 
• **During this period, the temperature starts to drop, and the humidity level also decreases, making the weather pleasant and comfortable.**
 
• The transition from hot and humid weather to dry and cool weather is gradual and can be observed in the changing landscape, such as the foliage and the sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **September-October is still a part of the monsoon season and receives heavy rainfall.**
 
• **December-January is already the peak of the winter season with low temperatures and no rainfall.**
 
• The word transition means a process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.
 
• In this context, it refers to the change in weather conditions from hot and rainy to dry and cool.
